Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 246,731Chapters: 94/98Kudos: 646

Summary: Five years Damian waited for the last Miraculous Ladybug manga, and the ending sucks. Enraged, he boasted he could write a better story. A mischievous, fifth-dimensional imp quickly appears and gives him a chance to prove his claim. To prevent a disappointing ending, he must change the plot as he sees fit. What would a genius detective, Robin, do in the MLB Universe, to cause Chaos of course! ​He wakes up in a world where he is dead, but Alfred is his living ally. With just seven days until the plot kicks off, Damian dedicates himself to healing the fractured Batfamily, slowly putting the pieces back together. But he can multitask. To prevent the Love Square, he decides to aggressively befriend Marinette Dupain-Cheng the only way a Wayne knows how: by replacing her friends with competent ones and burying her under a mountain of gifts. Who knew purchasing platonic affection required so much cashmere? (I am currently writing the final arc. )

entry.title: We Read The Pattern Like A Mirror, Backward
entry.summary:
Author: SentiWayne

Rating: Not RatedLanguage: EnglishWords: 6,690Chapters: 1/30Kudos: 2

Summary: Monarch is dead. But Paris is far from safe. ​A new threat, a shadowy figure calling themselves Kunlun Glass, has seized control of the city's criminal underworld. Having been tasked with cracking the three-year-old case, Damian Wayne, the son of the World’s Greatest Detective, doesn't realize that he is looking for a single reflection when he should be looking at a shattered mirror of many faces. To catch a cabal that hides in plain sight, he must remember the oldest rule of the puzzle: Read the pattern like a mirror, backward. But he's distracted by a cold case of his own. ​The disappearance of his childhood friend, Marinette Dupain-Cheng. Marinette vanished without a trace, leaving behind a puzzle that defies all logic. And every answer Damian uncovers only serves to rewrite the question. How does a normal girl vanish completely? Why does every lead point to the dictatorial Mayor, Noe Luxus? And what is the meaning of the bright red light haunting Damian’s dreams? ​To find the truth, Damian will have to look beyond the shadows of Paris even as he prepares to take his own first steps into adulthood.

Summary: “The whole world will only know what Ladybug tells them. Her words will be the truth.” To the Parisian public, Ladybug wasn't a savior; she was a tyrant who abused absolute power, covered up for Hawk Moth, and allied herself with Chrysalis before being duly punished by a mysterious mystical Order. Thirty-two years later, a smuggling ring in the Gotham docks ends with a vandalized and smashed statue, from which a confused Parisian teenager emerges. Bruce knows that the young woman in his infirmary is classified as a highly dangerous threat, but when Tim discovers classified files and a school photograph reveals the face of a young Talia al Ghul, things start to get complicated. With Marinette Dupain-Cheng seemingly without memory and unsure of who to trust, Bruce will have to discover whether he's protecting a victim or harboring the monster described in the official files.
